oneOf.description: The host explicitly requests generation; opening never generates.
The protocol exposes real start/finish events and a verified input boundary.
Context is local; rebuilding an idle projection has no remote session-creation effect.
Context replacement is acknowledged before another generation may start.
A generation consumes a stream until the host seals its user input.
Enable or pause remote audio input processing without closing the input port.
Durable context to be delivered to the model, distinct from UI progress.

outcome.description: Kernel-owned operation settlement. Adapter data remains unchanged.

ProviderToolOutcome.description:
Settlement metadata owned by the runtime. Content is stored once, in the
provider call's output, so resource normalization cannot create two versions.

alternatives.description: Exact, ordered alternatives. An empty list prohibits semantic degradation.

RunOptions.description: Effective parameters frozen when a run starts and persisted with every checkpoint.

input_audio_enabled.description: Latest committed audio input mode; pending commands record remote settlement.
